There is no necessary correction warranting conversion into an established start and an assertion that all three conditions were met. The supplied record neither reports northern measurement/completion nor confirms compliance or approval; the truth of those added assertions remains unknown rather than disproved by silence. The edit removes the target qualification and introduces both certainty and a causal claim of fulfilled conditions, so it fails to preserve meaning. It is contextually unsafe beside the all-three-points prerequisite and the sentence acknowledging the absent northern value. Correcting the eastern value with P1 cannot establish the missing third measurement or approval. No proposed patch supplies a dependency that makes P2 safe; dependency analysis is complete. The replacement is mechanically valid: its before span is exact and unique, its after text expresses the assessed stronger claim, and it has no overlap conflict.
